plugins.name: reraise-trove
plugins.description: Trove — cleanup desk for you and your agents: two-pane file desk, tamper-evident log, receipt reading, knowledge cards. Agents read freely and change files directly inside the folders you marked writable; agent tasks run with Hermes' own permissions; an optional switch makes every new task card and every MCP request wait for your release in the Trove tab.
